title: Dear Santa Please Fix My Backhand Funny Pickleball Christmas Sweatshirt, Gift for Pickleball Player
description:
The only thing on this player's Christmas list is a better backhand. Written like a letter to Santa, with a pair of paddles and a festive ball.

Who it's for:
- Players working on their backhand (so, everyone)
- Gift givers who want something funnier than a gift card
- Holiday round-robins and club parties

About the design:
Gold script, cream lettering and a big lime 'BACKHAND' sit above two paddles and a Santa-hatted pickleball. 'I've been good. Mostly.' keeps it playful.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Dear Santa please fix my backhand design with two paddles and a Santa-hatted pickleball on a navy sweatshirt.
